characters.scope: five base READY reserve assets only; no gameplay kits, routes, attack poses or animation
characters.referencePolicy: Official episode preview frames visually inspected; existing project portraits and licensed/secondary images are supplemental and not certified production model sheets.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE individual full-body base READY sprite for the Infernal Versus character reserve catalogue, not an animation frame sequence.
Style: meticulous Helluva Boss 2D animation character drawing, crisp dark ink contours, clean flat cel colors and very restrained cel shadows, canonical design from the supplied references. No 3D, painterly rendering, photorealism or redesign.
Pose and framing: a calm neutral standing pose, lateral three-quarter view FACING SCREEN-RIGHT, eyes looking right; weight balanced, both feet planted on one shared ground line, arms relaxed with hands clearly readable. No punch, guard, attack, recoil, spell, weapon or added action. One complete character only, with the ENTIRE head, horns, hair, arms, tail and feet visible. Tall portrait composition, preferably 1024 by 1536, and generous clear margins on ALL sides, at least 7 percent around the complete silhouette. Keep feet near the same horizontal ground level, around 92 percent of canvas height. Ordinary fully clothed presentation, no added emphasis on body parts.
Background: TRUE fully transparent RGBA alpha, including all negative spaces between limbs and costume parts. No floor, scenery, cast shadow, glow, aura, checkerboard, white matte, border, labels, logo, lettering, collage, duplicate character, extra views or sheet.
Input roles: Image 1 is the existing project full-body identity reference, Image 2 is a cropped preview frame from the official Mastermind episode and governs head/face and screen-right orientation, Image 3 is licensed merchandise used only for supplementary costume detail. Do not draw the standee, base, name lettering, packaging or any other character.
Subject: VASSAGO in the regular Mastermind court outfit. Preserve the very tall slender avian silhouette: red feathers, white cheek/face patches, short curved black beak, swept-back red crest with long dark-purple feather tips and fine golden markings. Preserve the angular golden-yellow star/crown-shaped GLASSES across his eyes; these are eyewear, not an added royal crown. Keep the high red collar with gold inner trim, red fitted jacket with black lapels, small white front panel with two dark buttons, golden star at the throat, dark-purple trouser/hip shapes, white long gloves with jagged dark cuffs and two thin red stripes on each forearm, long white boots with dark toes and the small black X marks. Keep the long orange-yellow tail feathers with dark tips fully within frame. Hands relaxed at his sides, composed expression, exact recognizable costume silhouette. Do not add wings, weapons or magic effects.
